request.cursor: null or the previous response cursor

response.conversations: distinct {userId, conversationId} scopes committed during this wait, or null when a gap invalidates every subscription

semantics.authority: Authenticated application transport control; hints grant no read, execution or ownership authority. Browser delivery rechecks each owned conversation through the canonical replay query.
semantics.commit: The same commit that appends conversation changes publishes invalidations before delivery acknowledgement. Failed statements publish nothing; an ambiguous COMMIT may harmlessly invalidate.
semantics.subscribe: One API lifecycle watch, enrolled before accepting streams. Every stream subscribes before its first durable replay. A changed cursor between waits invalidates all subscribed scopes.
semantics.idle: Waits consume no semantic transaction, receipt or query. The existing conversation heartbeat deadline bounds a transport wait; unchanged responses never trigger replay.
semantics.reconnect: Lost responses and a new authority epoch invalidate all subscriptions. Existing durable-worker failure backoff governs reconnect, with no new retry setting.
semantics.retention: Only current generations and distinct scopes of currently waiting connections are retained. No durable rows, notification history or user data are added.
semantics.shutdown: Authority shutdown wakes all waits. API shutdown interrupts and joins its exact borrowed connection before storage teardown. Cancelled pooled sessions are retired.
